source: rp game with a big map and u can change u outfit lot of new choices

image_prompt.text: An oversized town square at the centre of the map where roleplayers gather without jamming the exits
Detailed scenic spots - a fountain, a park, a plaza - built as backdrops for roleplay scenes and screenshots
A distinct structure visible from across the big map so players can navigate by sight
outfit-changing stations spread around the map where players swap their look

notes: Static settlement was chosen because the prompt asks for a big map and outfit changes but never mentions owning, claiming or building a house - personalization here is through the avatar
No option in this genre covers a changing room or wardrobe kiosk; preparation booths only exist inside the stage-runway shape, which this is not, so the request is carried as free text

open_questions.ask: What should the town look like - modern city, small suburb, fantasy village?
How big is big - a walkable town, or an open world you would want a vehicle for?
Should outfits come from the Roblox catalog, or a custom wardrobe you want us to build?
Do players get their own house or apartment, or is the whole map shared space?

coverage_missing.ask: What setting should the town have?
How big should the map be?
Are there player homes, or is it all public space?

answers.ask: What should the town look like - modern city, small suburb, fantasy village?
answers.answer: Make it a modern city for the RP setting.

answers.ask: How big is big - a walkable town, or an open world you would want a vehicle for?
answers.answer: Make it a walkable town-sized map; it should feel big but stay easy to explore on foot.

answers.ask: Should outfits come from the Roblox catalog, or a custom wardrobe you want us to build?
answers.answer: Use a custom wardrobe with lots of outfit choices so players can change their look in-game.

answers.ask: Do players get their own house or apartment, or is the whole map shared space?
answers.answer: Keep the whole map as shared space; the prompt does not call for player housing.
